{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:34:50.580412Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.476079ms","elapsed_secs":0.001476079},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:34:20.614312Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"32.379221ms","elapsed_secs":0.032379221},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:50.676240Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.008668ms","elapsed_secs":0.001008668},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:50.675060Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT e.id AS entry_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            e.id AS entry_id,\n            e.service_id,\n            e.submitted_by_user_id,\n            ev.display_name AS event_display_name\n        FROM global_promo_entries e\n        JOIN global_promo_events ev ON ev.id = e.event_id\n        WHERE ev.status = 'archived'\n          AND e.status <> 'ended'\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"2.813361ms","elapsed_secs":0.002813361},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:50.673953Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.458298ms","elapsed_secs":0.001458298},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:50.671433Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT e.id AS entry_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            e.id AS entry_id,\n            e.service_id,\n            e.submitted_by_user_id,\n            ev.display_name AS event_display_name\n        FROM global_promo_entries e\n        JOIN global_promo_events ev ON ev.id = e.event_id\n        WHERE ev.status = 'live'\n          AND e.status = 'approved'\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"905.793µs","elapsed_secs":0.000905793},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:23.658984Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')                       AS completed,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'processing'))      AS pending\n        FROM media_distribution\n        WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"789.037µs","elapsed_secs":0.000789037},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:23.657409Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'view')   AS views,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'share')  AS shares,\n            COALESCE(AVG((metadata ->> 'quality_score')::float), 0.0) AS avg_quality\n        FROM media_engagement\n        WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n          AND event_type IN ('view', 'share', 'quality_score')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"807.657µs","elapsed_secs":0.000807657},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:31:20.579210Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.49342ms","elapsed_secs":0.00149342},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:53.653070Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT job_id, status, updated_at …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT job_id, status, updated_at\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')\n          AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'\n        ORDER BY updated_at ASC\n        LIMIT 10\n        \n","rows_affected":7,"rows_returned":7,"elapsed":"1.466359ms","elapsed_secs":0.001466359},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.630212Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT id, delivery_id, zone_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            SELECT\n                id,\n                delivery_id,\n                zone_id,\n                status,\n                priority,\n                attempt_count,\n                payload,\n                next_attempt_at,\n                enqueued_at,\n                updated_at\n            FROM delivery_matching_queue\n            WHERE status IN ('queued', 'searching')\n              AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()\n            ORDER BY priority ASC, next_attempt_at ASC\n            LIMIT $1\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"7.48758ms","elapsed_secs":0.00748758},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.628501Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT enumlabel FROM pg_catalog.pg_enum …","db.statement":"\n\n\nSELECT enumlabel\nFROM pg_catalog.pg_enum\nWHERE enumtypid = $1\nORDER BY enumsortorder\n            \n","rows_affected":9,"rows_returned":9,"elapsed":"2.089338ms","elapsed_secs":0.002089338},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.626371Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT oid::regtype::text, typtype, typcategory, …","db.statement":"\n\nSELECT oid::regtype::text, typtype, typcategory, typrelid, typelem, typbasetype FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE oid = $1\n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"2.276786ms","elapsed_secs":0.002276786},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.579885Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"804.997µs","elapsed_secs":0.000804997},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.578233Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"847.889µs","elapsed_secs":0.000847889},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:50.577867Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT e.id AS entry_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            e.id AS entry_id,\n            e.service_id,\n            e.submitted_by_user_id,\n            ev.display_name AS event_display_name\n        FROM global_promo_entries e\n        JOIN global_promo_events ev ON ev.id = e.event_id\n        WHERE ev.status = 'archived'\n          AND e.status <> 'ended'\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"738.124µs","elapsed_secs":0.000738124},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.653382Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')                       AS completed,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'processing'))      AS pending\n        FROM media_distribution\n        WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"834.939µs","elapsed_secs":0.000834939},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.651724Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'view')   AS views,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'share')  AS shares,\n            COALESCE(AVG((metadata ->> 'quality_score')::float), 0.0) AS avg_quality\n        FROM media_engagement\n        WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n          AND event_type IN ('view', 'share', 'quality_score')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"1.497579ms","elapsed_secs":0.001497579},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.649400Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total\n        FROM media\n        WHERE media_type = 'video'\n          AND uploaded_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"1.029448ms","elapsed_secs":0.001029448},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.647487Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT job_id, status, updated_at …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT job_id, status, updated_at\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')\n          AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'\n        ORDER BY updated_at ASC\n        LIMIT 10\n        \n","rows_affected":7,"rows_returned":7,"elapsed":"833.429µs","elapsed_secs":0.000833429},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.645858Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'completed'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"786.967µs","elapsed_secs":0.000786967},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.644242Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'completed'\n          AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"791.347µs","elapsed_secs":0.000791347},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.640689Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'failed'\n          AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"794.137µs","elapsed_secs":0.000794137},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:38.639011Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT status, COUNT(*)::bigint AS …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT status, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        GROUP BY status\n        \n","rows_affected":2,"rows_returned":2,"elapsed":"925.063µs","elapsed_secs":0.000925063},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.651594Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')                       AS completed,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'processing'))      AS pending\n        FROM media_distribution\n        WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"804.867µs","elapsed_secs":0.000804867},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.650025Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'view')   AS views,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'share')  AS shares,\n            COALESCE(AVG((metadata ->> 'quality_score')::float), 0.0) AS avg_quality\n        FROM media_engagement\n        WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n          AND event_type IN ('view', 'share', 'quality_score')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"796.267µs","elapsed_secs":0.000796267},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.648424Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total\n        FROM media\n        WHERE media_type = 'video'\n          AND uploaded_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"876.19µs","elapsed_secs":0.00087619},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.646695Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT job_id, status, updated_at …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT job_id, status, updated_at\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')\n          AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'\n        ORDER BY updated_at ASC\n        LIMIT 10\n        \n","rows_affected":7,"rows_returned":7,"elapsed":"834.959µs","elapsed_secs":0.000834959},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.645026Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'completed'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"835.879µs","elapsed_secs":0.000835879},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.643337Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'completed'\n          AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"843.37µs","elapsed_secs":0.00084337},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.641615Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'failed'\n          AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"803.248µs","elapsed_secs":0.000803248},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:23.639924Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT status, COUNT(*)::bigint AS …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT status, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        GROUP BY status\n        \n","rows_affected":2,"rows_returned":2,"elapsed":"905.142µs","elapsed_secs":0.000905142},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:20.582176Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"2.064456ms","elapsed_secs":0.002064456},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:20.579264Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.29831ms","elapsed_secs":0.00129831},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:08.658675Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')                       AS completed,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'processing'))      AS pending\n        FROM media_distribution\n        WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"812.787µs","elapsed_secs":0.000812787},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:08.657004Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'view')   AS views,\n            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'share')  AS shares,\n            COALESCE(AVG((metadata ->> 'quality_score')::float), 0.0) AS avg_quality\n        FROM media_engagement\n        WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n          AND event_type IN ('view', 'share', 'quality_score')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"787.507µs","elapsed_secs":0.000787507},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:08.655418Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total\n        FROM media\n        WHERE media_type = 'video'\n          AND uploaded_at >= NOW() - ($1::int * INTERVAL '1 day')\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"837.03µs","elapsed_secs":0.00083703},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:08.653797Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT job_id, status, updated_at …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT job_id, status, updated_at\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running')\n          AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'\n        ORDER BY updated_at ASC\n        LIMIT 10\n        \n","rows_affected":7,"rows_returned":7,"elapsed":"885.541µs","elapsed_secs":0.000885541},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:30:08.652108Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS last_completed\n        FROM video_generation_jobs\n        WHERE status = 'completed'\n        \n","rows_affected":1,"rows_returned":1,"elapsed":"838.939µs","elapsed_secs":0.000838939},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.623567Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT id, delivery_id, zone_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            SELECT\n                id,\n                delivery_id,\n                zone_id,\n                status,\n                priority,\n                attempt_count,\n                payload,\n                next_attempt_at,\n                enqueued_at,\n                updated_at\n            FROM delivery_matching_queue\n            WHERE status IN ('queued', 'searching')\n              AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()\n            ORDER BY priority ASC, next_attempt_at ASC\n            LIMIT $1\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"977.766µs","elapsed_secs":0.000977766},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.580849Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"UPDATE live_flash_sales SET status …","db.statement":"\n\nUPDATE live_flash_sales SET status = 'ended', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'live') AND end_at <= $1\n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"762.696µs","elapsed_secs":0.000762696},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.579214Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.137763ms","elapsed_secs":0.001137763},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.577485Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT e.id AS entry_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n        SELECT\n            e.id AS entry_id,\n            e.service_id,\n            e.submitted_by_user_id,\n            ev.display_name AS event_display_name\n        FROM global_promo_entries e\n        JOIN global_promo_events ev ON ev.id = e.event_id\n        WHERE ev.status = 'archived'\n          AND e.status <> 'ended'\n        \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"760.206µs","elapsed_secs":0.000760206},"target":"sqlx::query"}
{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.577316Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT lfs.id, lfs.live_session_id, lfs.service_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                lfs.ending_notification_sent_at,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                ls.metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.end_at <= $1\n              AND lfs.ending_notification_sent_at IS NULL\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.847656ms","elapsed_secs":0.001847656},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:50.574653Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"SELECT lfs.id, lfs.live_session_id, lfs.service_id, …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.promo_price_cfa,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                ls.metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'scheduled'\n              AND lfs.start_at <= $1\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"1.004547ms","elapsed_secs":0.001004547},"target":"sqlx::query"}

{"timestamp":"2025-11-29T15:29:20.578255Z","level":"DEBUG","fields":{"summary":"WITH reservations AS ( …","db.statement":"\n\n\n            WITH reservations AS (\n                SELECT flash_sale_id, SUM(quantity) AS reserved_quantity\n                FROM live_flash_sale_reservations\n                GROUP BY flash_sale_id\n            )\n            SELECT\n                lfs.id,\n                lfs.live_session_id,\n                lfs.service_id,\n                lfs.stock_target,\n                COALESCE(res.reserved_quantity, 0) AS reserved_quantity,\n                lfs.commentary_interval_seconds,\n                lfs.last_commentary_sent_at,\n                lfs.end_at,\n                COALESCE(lfs.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS flash_metadata,\n                ls.host_user_id,\n                ls.service_id AS primary_service_id,\n                COALESCE(ls.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS session_metadata,\n                ls.title\n            FROM live_flash_sales lfs\n            JOIN live_sessions ls ON ls.id = lfs.live_session_id\n            LEFT JOIN reservations res ON res.flash_sale_id = lfs.id\n            WHERE lfs.status = 'live'\n              AND lfs.commentary_mode = 'ai_voice'\n              AND lfs.end_at > $1\n              AND (\n                    lfs.last_commentary_sent_at IS NULL\n                    OR lfs.last_commentary_sent_at <= $1 - make_interval(secs => lfs.commentary_interval_seconds)\n              )\n            \n","rows_affected":0,"rows_returned":0,"elapsed":"786.067µs","elapsed_secs":0.000786067},"target":"sqlx::query"}
